title: Super Simple Software Factory: Deterministic AI Workflows
description: Super Simple Software Factory packages repeatable AI agents-plus-code workflows into a single installable skill. It uses deterministic Python to control agent execution loops, retries, and acceptance criteria. Super Simple Software Factory moves control out of prompts into Python scripts, ensuring predictable and observable multi-agent coding workflows.
